findings.claim: Git-quoted filenames falsely block reviews that correctly report the actual paths.
findings.evidence: Scope uses 'git diff --name-only' without '-z', then 'diff.stdout.splitlines()'. Git quotes paths containing non-ASCII characters under default core.quotePath, and paths containing tabs or quotes. _norm() does not decode Git quoting. An in-memory probe with files_reviewed=['café.md'] and required_files=['"caf\\303\\251.md"'] returned 'files in scope not reviewed'. Copying the quoted spelling instead passes without identifying the actual repository path.
findings.suggested_fix: Request NUL-delimited names with git diff --name-only -z and split on NUL, preserving actual filenames. Add regression cases for Unicode, tabs and quotes.
